Name: More Beach Forage
Author: po0pfart
Description:
This mod overhauls beach daily spawn with fully configurable spawn chance for forage, crab pot catch, fish, treasure and junk items.

Spawn attempt is also configurable, allowing from slow natural like feel to dense and highly rewarding gameplay experience.

All spawns have its sub category with each item has configurable spawn chance as following:

[list]
[*]Forage consist of coral, sea urchin, nautilus shell, rainbow shell, seaweed and sea jelly
[*]Crab pot catch consists of lobster, clam, crab, cockle, mussel, shrimp and oyster
[*]Fish consists of sardine, flounder, anchovy, herring, halibut, eel, octopus, tilapia, red mullet, red snapper, tuna, pufferfish, super cucumber, sea cucumber, albacore and squid
[*]Treasure consists of pearl, treasure chest, golden coconut, diamond and prismatic shard
[*]Junk consists of joja cola, trash, driftwood, broken glasses, broken cd and soggy newspaper
[/list]Other spawn category does not have spawn chance, but instead spawn tries per day and maximum spawn number:

[list]
[*]Supply crate
[*]Mussel stone
[*]Fossil stone
[*]Clay stone
[*]Pot Of Gold
[*]Dig spot
[/list]Check out my other QoL mods on:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/po0pfart/mods]po0pfart's Mods[/url]
